newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: US puts Malaysia end-Dec palm stocks at 925,000T.
newsitem.headline: US puts Malaysia end-Dec palm stocks at 925,000T.

text.p: Malaysia's palm oil stocks are expected to rise to 925,000 tonnes at end-December 1996 from 860,000 tonnes at end-December 1995, according to an estimate in a report from the U.S. embassy here obtained on Thursday.
The report, prepared by the U.S. agricultural attache, did not give end-November stocks, but Malaysian palm oil traders have estimated these at between 950,000 to 970,000 tonnes.
Malaysia's Palm Oil Registration and Licensing Authority said end-October stocks were 953,241 tonnes compared with 894,438 tonnes at end-September.
Higher crude palm oil (CPO) output resulted in an increase in carry-out stocks at end-October, the U.S. report said.

"However, a seasonal downtrend in CPO output for the rest of the October-December period is expected to weigh on the carry-out stocks at the end of calendar year 1996 to around 920,000 to 930,000 tonnes," the report said.
Between January to October 1996 Malaysian CPO output totalled 6.98 million tonnes versus 6.42 million tonnes in the same period last year.
The report said CPO output in November was expected to fall between 10 to 15 percent from October's level.
-- Tan Lee Lee, Kuala Lumpur newsroom (230-7510)
